summary: Schema 1.2 is the only accepted Concord knowledge manifest shape. The unwired schema 1.0 and 1.1 migration, its transient undecided-root marker, and its compatibility validation branches are removed before launch. This amends CD-0041 D9.2 and CD-0062 D3 while preserving the current root-home rationale and PM1.Q10 projection rules.
title: The current knowledge manifest has no legacy migration path
